anchored_wall.title: Anchored excavation
anchored_wall.description: Ground anchor design: free length, bond length, tendon selection and design, test and lock-off loads.
anchored_wall.design.heading: Anchor design
anchored_wall.error.missing_inputs: Required anchor design inputs are missing: {missing}
anchored_wall.check.overburden: Minimum cover over the bond zone centre
anchored_wall.warning.bond_length_exceed: Bond length {bond_length} m; capacity gain beyond about {typical_max} m is not reliable (GEC-4 5.3.6).
anchored_wall.warning.inclination_outsid: Inclination {inclination}° is outside the usual GEC-4 range of {min}°–{max}°.
anchored_wall.warning.overburden_low: Cover over the bond zone centre is {depth} m; at least {required} m is required (GEC-4 5.3.7).
anchored_wall.warning.phi_zero_wedge: φ′ = 0: failure surface taken at 45°; the GEC-4 method is for cohesionless soil.
anchored_wall.assumption.beyond_wedge_de: The bond zone starts {value} m behind the failure surface: max(1.5 m, 0.2 H) (GEC-4 5.3.4 says H/5 or 1.5 m; the larger is taken).
anchored_wall.assumption.wedge_origin_at: The failure surface starts at the excavation base corner (GEC-4 5.3.2).
anchored_wall.assumption.level_ground_ve: Level retained ground and a vertical wall face are assumed; sloping ground is not supported yet.
anchored_wall.home.heading: Anchor design (the screen is added in a later phase)
anchored_wall.warning.strand_count_not_i: {count} strands is not listed in GEC-4 Table 10; capacity is taken as a multiple of one strand.
anchored_wall.warning.test_factor_below_: Test load factor {value} is below the GEC-4 value of 1.33.
anchored_wall.warning.limit_above_gec4: The {limit} load limit {value} exceeds the GEC-4 limit (0.6 / 0.7 / 0.8 SMTS).
anchored_wall.warning.min_free_length_be: Minimum unbonded length {value} m is below the GEC-4 minimum of {gec4} m.
anchored_wall.warning.safety_factor_belo: FS {value} is below the GEC-4 guidance of {guidance}.
anchored_wall.warning.transfer_load_unre: No source was given for the load transfer / bond value; presumptive values must be verified by anchor tests.
anchored_wall.assumption.transfer_load_r: Load transfer value source: {ref} (preliminary design; verify by anchor tests).
anchored_wall.assumption.gec4_test_facto: Maximum test load = {value} × design load (GEC-4 pp. 75-77).
anchored_wall.assumption.gec4_tendon_lim: Tendon limits 0.6 / 0.7 / 0.8 SMTS (design / lock-off / test), GEC-4 p. 77.
anchored_wall.assumption.overburden_not_: Rock anchor: the 4.5 m cover rule (GEC-4 5.3.7, for soil anchors) is not checked.
